Game Overview

Mini Blocks is a pixel title where guide a charming blue blob through whimsical, block-filled levels in Mini Blocks. Navigate obstacles, activate blocks, and avoid perilous spikes. With simple controls and an automatic blob movement, enjoy the delightful challenge of timing and strategic maneuvers, aiming for glowing portals. Embark on an enchanting, bouncy adventure!
